study.question: Does the loss from mean-direction deletion arise mainly from a smaller pre-product upstream-gradient norm or from losing its direction, and does that explanation depend on auxiliary adapter-context transfer? Can a norm-restored implementation recover or improve the incumbent under unchanged capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The similar transfer-enabled losses after deleting the mean or alternating direction in g0-r0064 suggest a shared magnitude effect is plausible, but do not establish it. Restoring the native per-vector norm after mean deletion should recover a substantial part of the click-AUC loss if reduced gradient magnitude is the main cause; shrinking the unprojected vector to the deleted vector norm should reproduce a loss. The blocked-context results may instead retain a directional effect. This is a diagnostic hypothesis about the existing compressed task-conditioned product model, not a new external architecture or an established explanation.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local implementation: same forward-identity insertion before live R(x)=x/sqrt(mean(x^2)+1e-4), but its VJP is P*v and changes direction and magnitude together. New first-order backward separately restores the projected norm or shrinks the native direction, crossed with the same context gate. Archived source hashes were verified.

study.proposed_difference: For incoming v=J_R(x)^T*g at each task product, let p=v-mean(v), a=||p||_2/||v||_2. New mean_restored returns p*||v||_2/||p||_2 (zero if p=0), while native_shrunk returns a*v (zero if v=0). Both alternatives are computed in every training cell; evaluation bypasses the helper. Compute norms after a common per-vector max-absolute rescaling to avoid squaring tiny raw gradients; do not clip the norm ratio. The native RMS forward and derivative run outside the helper and remain live. Archived v and p cells complete a direction-by-norm-by-context-transfer factorial at the same parameter count. This deliberately changes first-order backward, not forward information, training loss weights or host optimizers.
predictions: Magnitude-dominant prediction: mean_restored_transfer improves click AUC over g0-r0064-mean_removed_transfer and approaches g0-r0063-uncentered_native, while native_shrunk_transfer loses AUC against that native control. Predeclare 0.0001 AUC as a practical descriptive resolution, not a significance threshold.

Directional alternative: native_shrunk_transfer recovers native performance while mean_restored_transfer remains impaired. Evaluate this alternative explicitly instead of selecting only a winning result.

At common nonzero-output parameters all cells have identical predictions and output-matrix gradients; mean_restored has the direction of p and native norm when p is nonzero, and native_shrunk has the direction of v and norm ||p||. Both zero/constant-v degeneracies return finite zeros.

Crossed context gates quantify whether the explanation depends on allowed auxiliary context updates; global direction/norm changes also affect primary/history-projection parameters, so they cannot be called an isolated auxiliary-context intervention.

Only a candidate exceeding the incumbent 0.6685268680116033, as well as both source bests 0.660646940486458 and 0.660163362657485, at measured acceptable cost is a predictive advance. Diagnostic recovery alone is not an improvement.
falsifiers: A direction-only loss persists at matched native vector norm while unprojected magnitude reduction recovers native quality: reject the magnitude-dominant explanation for this implementation.
Neither restored direction nor scalar shrinkage follows the predicted contrasts, or the gate interaction reverses: retain a mixed/interaction explanation rather than claiming a unique mechanism.

Forward/state/initialization/source-gate parity fails, numerical gradients are nonfinite, or incoming-vector norm/direction identities fail beyond dtype tolerance: reject implementation readiness before interpreting performance.
No new cell exceeds the incumbent: record a null/negative predictive result and keep the incumbent, even if attribution is informative.
A promising difference disappears under admissible paired-seed repetition or is explained by materially higher measured cost: do not claim repeated mechanism support or efficiency.
alternative_explanations: Different norms of the removed mean and alternating components, rather than a privileged mean direction, can explain the previous rank-matched-projector contrast.

Adaptive optimization, minibatch Dice moments, dense gradient clipping, sparse repeated-ID accumulation and interaction with the residual branch can transform a locally norm-matched intervention into different parameter updates.
All four tasks get the product VJP intervention, and the context gate covers both the residual and product adapters; effects are not specific to one task or one parameter family.
Scale restoration can amplify a numerically unreliable nearly constant projected direction; exact-zero projections cannot retain native norm.
Single seed, many adaptive validation rounds and nonindependent same-seed replays limit inference; four-task auxiliaries have a material tradeoff against DIN despite better click AUC.
Fixed offline visibility and category/brand-based auxiliary label semantics limit transfer to online attribution or mature-feedback settings.
